newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yaohan Japan to have new president.
newsitem.headline: Yaohan Japan to have new president.

text.p: Yaohan Japan Corp said on Friday that its president Terumasa Wada would resign and its current vice-president Mitsumasa Wada take over on January 10, 1997.
Yaohan Japan said it was aiming to develop its business by installing a younger president.
Terumasa Wada is 65 years old while Mitsumasa Wada is 58, the company said. Terumasa Wada will become vice chairman.
Yaohan Japan is one of the four core companies of the Yaohan group. The group has actively expanded overseas, especially in China, over the past few years. Yaohan Japan runs retail outlets in Japan.
